subject.title: fix(gateway): replace buggy isPrivateOrLoopbackHost with canonical net.ts import

question: Should this PR require real gateway pricing-cache refresh proof before merge, or should maintainers waive the proof gate for this internal classifier fix?
rationale: The code path and tests look correct, but the contributor proof does not show the actual runtime pricing-cache refresh/fetch-skip behavior that ClawSweeper requires for external PRs.

options.title: Require runtime refresh proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a real gateway pricing-cache refresh showing a CGNAT/private endpoint skipped and a public endpoint fetched before merge.

options.title: Waive contributor proof
options.body: A maintainer can accept the source-level tests and CI as enough for this internal gateway path while owning the compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Require runtime refresh proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a real gateway pricing-cache refresh showing a CGNAT/private endpoint skipped and a public endpoint fetched before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent merged work on the gateway model-pricing cache and is the strongest routing candidate for proof sufficiency on this surface.
